_about: Sponsor booths. `venue` must be a key in venues.json. A booth pays once per account, ever, and the QR poster on the table carries a code the server derives from the booth id and QR_HMAC_SECRET — the code is never written here, so a copy of this pack is not a set of free karma. A `sticker` reward must be an item id from memorabilia.json; a `powerUp` must be a type from the power-up catalog. Sponsor names are the fictional ones the pack uses everywhere else, not real companies.

booths.name: Boneyard Labs Bench
booths.blurb: Two engineers, one oscilloscope, and a bowl of resistors nobody is counting.

booths.name: Prairie Compute Rack
booths.blurb: They brought a half-height rack up the stairs. Ask them about it.

booths.name: Quad Robotics Pit
booths.blurb: The arm on the table will hand you a sticker if you ask it politely enough.

booths.name: Orange Krush Cloud Kiosk
booths.blurb: Free credits, a whiteboard, and a queue that forms around 2 AM.

booths.name: Chime Analytics Desk
booths.blurb: They are quietly plotting every commit in the room and will show you yours.

booths.name: Lincoln Avionics Stand
booths.blurb: A wind tunnel the size of a shoebox, and someone happy to explain it twice.

booths.name: Saucer Systems Counter
booths.blurb: Named for the building, not the other way round. They are very clear about that.

booths.name: Altgeld Security Table
booths.blurb: Bring them a bug and they will buy you a coffee. Bring them two and they will hire you.
